_comment: Expansion 3 part D.4: level 9 spells of the 2024 Player's Handbook (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md). Wish is written by the main session; spells that wait for Part E or F are not here.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.text: You touch a willing creature and it glimpses the next moment (eight hours): it has Advantage on every attack roll, save and check, and attacks against it have Disadvantage.

mass_heal.name: Mass Heal
mass_heal.text: A flood of healing energy restores up to 700 hit points among your friends within 60 feet, the most hurt first, and ends the blindness, deafness and poison on each one healed.

meteor_swarm.name: Meteor Swarm
meteor_swarm.text: Four blazing orbs plummet to the ground within a mile, each bursting in a 40-foot sphere: everyone caught, once, makes a Dexterity save or takes 20d6 fire and 20d6 bludgeoning, half on a save. Dry things catch fire.

power_word_heal.name: Power Word Heal
power_word_heal.text: A wave of healing washes over a friend within 60 feet: all its hit points return, and a charm, fear, paralysis, poison, stun or fall to the ground is undone.

power_word_kill.name: Power Word Kill
power_word_kill.text: You compel a creature within 60 feet to die. If it has 100 hit points or fewer it dies; otherwise it takes 12d12 psychic damage.

prismatic_wall.name: Prismatic Wall
prismatic_wall.text: A shimmering wall of seven colours rises within 60 feet (ten minutes). Nothing passes it. Foes who come within 20 feet of it or start a turn there make a Constitution save or are blinded for a minute.

storm_of_vengeance.name: Storm of Vengeance

stages.say: Acid rain pours from the storm.
Lightning lances down from the storm.
Freezing rain and gusts lash the ground.

storm_of_vengeance.text: A storm cloud 300 feet across gathers up to a mile away (concentration): foes under it save or take 2d6 thunder and are deafened; each later turn brings acid rain, six lightning bolts, hail, then freezing gales.

time_stop.name: Time Stop
time_stop.text: You stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself and take 1d4+1 turns in a row. The spell ends as soon as anything you do reaches another creature.

weird.name: Weird
weird.text: Illusory terrors fill the minds of your foes in a 30-foot sphere within 120 feet (concentration). Wisdom save or take 10d10 psychic and be frightened; half on a save. A frightened foe takes 5d10 at the end of each turn until it saves.

wish.name: Wish
wish.text: The mightiest spell. In a fight, copy any battle spell of level 8 or lower with no components (safe), or wish for Instant Health: you and twenty friends whole again. That brings the stress: Strength 5 for days, every spell hurts until a long rest, and Wish may be lost.
